items.title: The from_short gate blocks every long video on this long-first channel
items.detail: generator/topics.py winning_short() requires a long topic to name one of our Shorts (100+ views, top third by stayed to watch). Disaster Desk is long-first (recipe.md: each Short promotes a long video), its only Short has 0 views and is about Lac-Mégantic, so no long topic can pass check-plan. The new-channel exemption ended when the first promo Short published (21 Nov).
items.outcome: Fixed by the owner's rule of 2026-11-22: generator/topics.py no longer blocks a long topic on from_short or a Short's views (winning_short removed, on every channel); scripts/guard.py refuses a branch that brings it back. state --format long shows every feed topic usable.

items.title: Long-video hook: small cause plus its scale in the first 15 s (owner's note of 22 Nov)
items.detail: The owner asked (feedback cmwrnoaza0001jv09ogy086yi) for the Hyatt video's hook to say up front that a small issue killed this many people. The reference shot sheets agree: Fault Lines' Learjet video (11K subs, 1.94M views, 176x its subscribers) states the outcome at 5-17 s ('a minute later it hit a road almost vertically; nine aboard, none lived') and the promise at 17-30 s; Inside Decoded's Short (1.9M) opens on a figure in the first line. The slow openers are the weaker ones: Plainly Difficult's Kolkata flyover (1.1M subs, 628K, 0.57x) names its subject at 64 s; Major Disasters' Spain train (186K) gives the stakes at 49-76 s after a 30 s condolence card. Studio: line 1 names the small cause and the scale (the toll stated plainly, once, with respect, no gore or 'horror' words); by 15 s the promise of the chain; frame 1 stays the 3D moment of failure with its date/place caption. Every feed topic Scout enriched on 23 Nov carries such a hook. How we'll know: first-30-s retention of the next two long videos vs the Hyatt (L-20261121-42) and Texas City (L-20261122-42) curves.

items.title: prompts/recipe.md 'The first 45 seconds' rule 4 ('without the toll') contradicts the owner's newer note
items.detail: Improver: rewrite rule 4 to 'The whole arc in 45 s, and in the first sentence the small cause and its scale (the toll stated once, plainly)'. The owner's note of 22 Nov is newer and wins (agents/policy.md), and the improver already flagged the conflict on the Notifications page. Studio's check: its hook names cause + scale by 15 s.

items.title: In cause-chain videos, name roles (the assistant bosun, the captain), never living individuals
items.detail: Herald, Colgan and Lac-Mégantic all turn on one person's action. The profile's defamation rule is 'the report's words only'; the safe way is roles in narration and real people's words only as on-screen transcript text. Each enriched topic's `verify` says which names to leave out.

items.title: Finish the Titan long video (L-20261124-41) from its saved branch instead of starting over
items.detail: Studio 2026-11-24 made the Titan submersible video in full: 79 beats, 558 s, 34 sourced facts (NTSB MIR-25-36 read in full, now in the feed topic), fact review PASS, number check and every render gate ok. It stopped only because QA round 2 still had 6 picture notes and Studio allows two rounds. Everything (script.json, plan.json, remotion/src/videos/L-20261124-41/, staged NTSB pages) is on branch claude/disaster-studio-c91jy3. Next Studio run: copy those files under a new id, fix the 6 notes listed in the failed manifest's failReason, and add one beat with scene 'chapter' at each chapter start so render.json has chapters. Then go straight to stills and QA. Lessons for every long video on this channel: (a) the cross-section look's white paper reads as empty to the craft gate unless the drafting grid is strong (96 px, #cddae6); (b) keep each flat stretch under about 30 s, cutting to a 3D beat between; (c) render.json only builds chapters from 'chapter' scene beats; (d) keep honesty tags and chapter cards right of the top-left badge (x 150).
items.outcome: Resumed the same day on the owner's word ('Fix and resume'): the 6 QA notes fixed, QA passed on round 3, rendered (558 s) and shipped as L-20261124-41.

items.title: Improver: the cross-section look's flat backgrounds fail the empty-frame gate
items.detail: With the kit's LookBackground for cross-section (white to #eef1f4) and the default faint grid, 44 of 111 stills of L-20261124-41 counted as mostly empty background (renderer/craft.py EMPTY_TILE_STD 7). The video's own code fixed it with a 96 px, 5 px #cddae6 grid. Worth making that the recipe's own sheet texture in remotion/src/disaster (Texture 'hatch' at 0.12 is too faint to register).

items.title: Two recap-and-tease beats in every long video, at about 30% and 65% of the runtime
items.detail: agents/scout.md asks for a recap-and-tease every 2-3 minutes, but only one of our three long videos has one. Hyatt (L-20261121-42) has one ('So far: a joint that was already weak... What was still missing? A crowd.'). Texas City (L-20261122-42) and Titan (L-20261124-41) have none. Studio: in each long script, add one beat of 8-12 s after the chain is set up (~30%) and one after the failure (~65%). Each beat names the links so far in one line and asks the question the next chapter answers. The topic outlines from 2026-11-26 (Carmont, Chatsworth, Air Canada 797) mark both. How we will know: once a long video passes about 100 views, its retention curve (stats drops) shows no step-down in the minute after each recap.

items.title: Hold the moment of failure to 50-60% of the runtime; it is the video's midpoint payoff, not its opening act
items.detail: The reference shot sheets (research/sheets/) put the failure late in the video. Kolkata flyover (Plainly Difficult, 628K): real collapse at 345 of 579 s (60%). Florida Learjet (Fault Lines, 1.94M): the dive at 362 of 608 s (60%). Spain train (Major Disasters, 186K): impact at 413 of 854 s (48%). Before it, the cause chain builds; after it come the findings, a general-principle physics chapter and the rule. The hook states the outcome (owner's note), but the full reconstruction is the reward for staying. Studio: put chapter 5 (the failure) at 50-60% of the length and keep the hook's 3D failure shot short (one beat). How we will know: average view percentage above 37.4%, our current best (Texas City).

items.title: Long videos: one hero picture revisited from a new angle in every chapter
items.detail: Fault Lines' Learjet video (1.94M views on 11K subs) keeps coming back to one 3D flight-path ribbon over a grid, with mono callouts at each event, seen from a new camera angle each time (0-30 s, 160 s, 350 s). The viewer always knows where they are in the story. Ours change place every chapter. Proposal for the improver: a long-video flag `hero_revisit`. With it on, the director gives each chapter's first beat the same hero place (the slope cross-section, track diagram or cabin cutaway named in the topic's outline) with a new camera and the next event marked. Half the long videos get it. Judge on average view percentage once both sides have 4 or more long videos with 100+ views.
